regime.label: RELIEF RALLY / RISK-ON OPEN -- THE NASDAQ 100 IS SNAPPING A FIVE-SESSION LOSING STREAK, AND IT LANDS ON THE DAY THE DESK'S QQQ PUT HITS ITS 21-DTE REVIEW
evidence: THE LEVEL THAT MATTERS: QQQ is back ABOVE its 50-day MA (713.05) after closing below it yesterday for the first time in this leg. That below-50d close was the technical CONFIRMATION the desk's bearish index premise rested on, and it is being undone at the open.

Leadership is semis, i.e. exactly what was leading the selloff: AVGO 371.37 (+2.02%), AMD 477.50 (+1.71%), TSM 422.48 (+1.56%), TSLA 350.19 (+1.47%), NVDA 218.64 (+0.83%). MSFT 480.70 (-0.09%) is the lone flat name.

VOL IS NOT BIDDING. Own-measured 30d ATM IV (2026-09-18 board, 28 DTE) FELL on both indexes versus yesterday: SPY 0.1315 -> 0.1285, QQQ 0.2027 -> 0.1985. Singles are mixed and small: NVDA 0.4032 -> 0.4066 (three sessions before its print), MSFT 0.2608 -> 0.2623, TSLA 0.4131 -> 0.4114. Yesterday's one-day 'vol has started to bid' reading did NOT hold, which retires it as a signal.

DRIVERS (press, not desk inference): long-bond yields stabilizing after the week's sell-off that had pressured capital-intensive AI names; Bitcoin ~$77k heading for its best week in nearly three years; traders awaiting detail on the administration's economic plan toward Iran. Nasdaq 100 futures were +0.6% and S&P futures +0.4% pre-open.
regime.implication: The desk's two open puts are on the wrong side of today's tape, and the QQQ 680P's unconditional 21-DTE review happens to land on the same session that its confirming technical is being undone. Name the coincidence rather than reading it as fate: the written invalidation (a QQQ close above ~730) is NOT hit at 714, so this is a judgment call about time decay, not a setup break. The correct action was to bring Ryan the decision with numbers, which this run did. On the entry side nothing changes: the bearish-tech theme is at its 2-of-2 cap so no new put is available, and buying calls into a one-day bounce that happens to reverse the desk's own book is a rationalization, not a thesis.

intraday_amendments.revised_label: FAILED BOUNCE / RISK-OFF REASSERTING -- the five-session losing streak is NOT being snapped; the attempt to snap it was sold.
evidence: QQQ 709.98 (-0.13%) at 14:24Z, versus 714.07 (+0.44%) at the open. Round trip of the entire gain and then some.

THE LEVEL: QQQ opened back ABOVE its 50-day (713.05) -- the single piece of evidence the 13:35Z brief leaned on -- and has closed back UNDER it intraday. The bearish confirmation the desk's book rests on is being RE-established, not undone.
Semis, which led the bounce, fully reversed: AMD 465.24 (-0.90%, was +1.71% at the open), NVDA 214.77 (-0.96%, was +0.83%), TSM 418.36 (+0.57%, was +1.56%), AVGO 367.74 (+1.02%, was +2.02%).

SPY 764.74 (+0.28%) is holding up far better than QQQ -- the weakness is concentrated in tech, not the broad tape, which is consistent with the desk's bearish-TECH positioning rather than a general risk-off.
TSLA 357.20 (+3.50%) is the clear outlier and the one name still working; it is carrying what remains of the Nasdaq bid.
Vol still did NOT bid on the day's own-measured readings (SPY 0.1285, QQQ 0.1985, both DOWN vs yesterday), so this is a failure of the bounce rather than a fear spike.
intraday_amendments.implication: Reverses this morning's read that the desk's two puts were 'on the wrong side of today's tape'. They are not -- the tape turned back toward them within the hour. This does NOT change the QQQ 21-DTE recommendation, which rests on theta (5.4% of mark per day at delta -0.20), not on direction: being right slowly is exactly how this vehicle loses. It DOES mean the position's written invalidation (a QQQ close above ~730) is further away, not closer. Explicitly NOT a licence to add a third bearish-tech leg -- that theme is at its hard 2-of-2 cap.
